title: Upper Chehalis people - Wikipedia
text: The Upper Chehalis are a Southwestern Coast Salish people Indigenous to Washington state.The traditional culture (at the beginning of the 19th century) of the Upper Chehalis is closely related to other Southwestern Coast Salish groups, although they have their regional differences.

title: Chehalis, Upper | Ethnologue Free
text: Upper Chehalis is a dormant language of the United States. It belongs to the Salish language family. The language is no longer used as a first language by any remaining members of the ethnic community.

title: Chehalis
text: The Chehalis, including the Upper Chehalis (Kwaiailk), Lower Chehalis, Copalis, Cowlitz, Humptulip, Oyhut, Satsop, and Shoalwater Salish, lived in southeastern Washington along the Chehalis, Satsop, and Cowlitz rivers.
